prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / game-sprite asset generation. Race: Human. Input1 is the UPDATED APPROVED body to match. Input2 is an OLD source guide for injury/limb details only; input3 when present is the old blood/stone pixel reference.

Crisp clustered PIXEL ART, match the input1 pixel cluster size and chunky dark outline; no smooth vector shapes or blurred miniature painting. Real transparent background. No labels, letters, frame borders, grid lines, scenery or cast shadows. No color-key background. Do not add normal/intact reference rows or extra subjects.
